subtitle: From measurements to material behaviour.
local: Local session · data stays on this computer
upload_hint: Up to 10 MB. CSV: comma, semicolon or tab.
complete: I confirm that fracture was recorded
select_range: Select a horizontal range in the plot to set the elastic interval.
sensitivity_note: Geometry variations are bounds, not confidence intervals. Geometry does not alter imported σ–ε data.
candidate_note: These are candidates; noise can also produce local peaks.
compare_empty: Analyze two or more samples and add them here.
preview_hint: First 20 rows; complete data is available in the CSV export.
method_intro: This tool analyzes monotonic tensile data. Review automatic selections. It does not certify standards compliance.
method_elastic: E: fit σ = Eε + b over the selected elastic interval. High R² alone does not prove elastic behaviour.
method_energy: Integrate using strain as a ratio. MPa × ratio = MJ/m³. Without confirmed fracture, only recorded-range energy is reported.
method_resilience: Resilience = σ_el²/(2E). Using Rp0.2 without a known elastic limit is labelled an estimate.
method_true: σ_true ≈ σ(1+ε), ε_true = ln(1+ε). Assumes approximate volume conservation and uniform extension; conversion stops at maximum load.
method_hardening: Hollomon: σ_true = K·ε_pl^n. Log fit over the selected positive plastic interval; post-necking data is excluded.
method_poisson: ν is the negative transverse–axial strain slope in the elastic interval. It requires transverse measurements.
method_ductility: Post-fracture length and area are separate measurements from the curve endpoint. Fracture toughness KIC and Charpy energy are not calculated.
method_data: Bundled datasets are deterministic synthetic models, not laboratory results or material certificates.
method_compare: Statistics are grouped by replicate group, material, temperature, gauge length, measurement method and source label.
duplicates: Duplicate measurements found; acquisition order was preserved.
missing_removed: Rows with missing numeric force/extension or stress/strain were removed.
zero_applied: First reading subtracted. Reconsider this correction if a physical preload is present.
strain_noise: Small backward strain steps exist; integration preserves acquisition order.
fracture_candidate: A load-drop fracture candidate was found. Confirm completeness or select the fracture row.
fracture_unconfirmed: Fracture was not automatically confirmed. Review the test record.
smoothed: Stress was smoothed; the raw curve is retained. Peaks and area may change.
poor_elastic_fit: Elastic fit R² < 0.995. Check the interval and measurement quality.
offset_intercept: The fitted intercept is appreciable. Review zero correction and elastic interval.
warn_crosshead: Crosshead motion includes machine compliance and slip; E may only be an apparent modulus.
no_necking_evidence: Maximum load is at the record endpoint; evidence for necking onset is insufficient.
no_proof: The 0.2% line did not intersect the recorded curve.
partial_energy: Energy covers the recorded interval only; it is not reported as full tensile toughness.
resilience_estimate: The elastic limit is unknown; resilience was estimated using Rp0.2.
poisson_check: Poisson's ratio is outside the expected isotropic elastic range. Check units and measurements.
no_lateral: Insufficient transverse measurements in the elastic interval; Poisson's ratio was not calculated.
no_hardening: Insufficient data for a hardening fit in the selected plastic interval.
no_time: No complete increasing time series; strain rate was not calculated.
invalid_geometry: Specimen dimensions must be positive; final area cannot exceed initial area.
missing_columns: Required selected columns were not found.
elastic_points: At least 5 distinct measurements are needed for the elastic fit. Widen the interval.
too_few_points: At least 12 valid measurements are required.
negative_data: Negative strain or no positive load found. Check signs and zero.
nonmonotonic: Significant strain reversal detected. Select a monotonic loading interval.
invalid_fracture: Fracture row is outside the valid interval or too early.
invalid_smoothing: Smoothing window must be odd, at least 5 and shorter than the data.
invalid_modulus: No positive Young's modulus found. Check the interval.
invalid_elastic_limit: Elastic limit must be positive and no greater than the measured maximum stress.
invalid_file: Could not read file. Check CSV or XLSX format.
session_expired: Dataset session not found; reload the file.
request_error: Request could not be completed. Check inputs.
no_notes: No additional automated flags; this alone does not establish measurement validity.
